description: FastQC-style deep quality-control report for a FASTQ file: per-base quality and content, GC and length distributions, sequence duplication levels, overrepresented sequences, and adapter content — each with a warn/fail verdict against FastQC's own published thresholds.

input.description: FASTQ text: records of an '@id' header, sequence, '+' separator and quality line (four lines each).

qualityOffset.description: ASCII offset of the FASTQ quality string. 33 for anything modern, 64 for pre-1.8 Illumina.

name: fastq_qc_report
title: FASTQ Deep QC Report
